===== postgres/marts.fct_daily/load.default.resolve.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild resolver for a rendered load operation. Generated by `render --write`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_daily
-- operation:       default
-- target:          postgres
-- strategy:        watermark_append
-- definition hash: cc5d3b3bee5655e4f5ce89b6035b1a267604df9161a563235ad0af3c35e329a8
-- matrix version:  bf77f3e4bc07
-- tool version:    0.1.0
-- parameters:      @watermark (DATE, resolver)
SELECT CAST(MAX("order_date") - INTERVAL '3 days' AS DATE) FROM "marts"."fct_daily";

===== postgres/marts.fct_daily/load.default.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild rendered load operation. Generated by `render --write`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_daily
-- operation:       default
-- target:          postgres
-- strategy:        watermark_append
-- definition hash: cc5d3b3bee5655e4f5ce89b6035b1a267604df9161a563235ad0af3c35e329a8
-- matrix version:  bf77f3e4bc07
-- tool version:    0.1.0
-- parameters:      @watermark (DATE, resolver)
BEGIN;
CREATE TEMP TABLE ddb_stage AS
WITH ddb_body AS (SELECT o.order_date, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM staging.orders AS o GROUP BY o.order_date)
SELECT "order_date", "total" FROM ddb_body WHERE ddb_body."order_date" >= @watermark;
DELETE FROM "marts"."fct_daily" WHERE "order_date" >= @watermark;
INSERT INTO "marts"."fct_daily" ("order_date", "total")
SELECT "order_date", "total" FROM ddb_stage;
DROP TABLE ddb_stage;
COMMIT;
